description: This is a Java source file defining a REST Controller in a Spring Boot application. It provides endpoints for greeting, documentation redirect, health check, and application info, utilizing Spring MVC annotations and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: Defines REST endpoints for greetings, documentation redirection, checking health, and providing app info, with Swagger annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Handles GET requests to root ('/') returning a welcome message.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/docs' providing a redirect to Swagger UI, building the URL based on incoming request headers.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Provides a health check endpoint returning 'OK'.
